scripts.check: node --check bin/strap-agent.js && node --check bin/strap-llm.js && node --check bin/strap-mcp.js && node --check bin/strap-run-calls.js && node --check bin/strap-state.js && node --check src/*.js && node --check mcp-servers/*.js
scripts.smoke: node bin/strap-state.js init > /tmp/strap-smoke.json && node bin/strap-state.js add-user 'hello' < /tmp/strap-smoke.json > /tmp/strap-smoke-2.json && node bin/strap-llm.js compile-openai --model test-model < /tmp/strap-smoke-2.json > /tmp/strap-openai.json && node bin/strap-agent.js fork --prompt 'inspect docs' < /tmp/strap-smoke-2.json > /tmp/strap-child.json && node bin/strap-agent.js fold --child /tmp/strap-child.json --summary 'child result' < /tmp/strap-smoke-2.json > /tmp/strap-folded.json && node -e 'import("./src/registry.js").then(async ({toolMap})=>{ const tool=toolMap("scripts").get("json_echo"); if(!tool) throw new Error("missing json_echo"); const result=await tool.execute({value:"ok"}); if(!result.content[0].text.includes("ok")) throw new Error(result.content[0].text); })'
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run smoke
